thresholded.text: I'm a weekend backpacker who hikes to exposed, remote sites in unpredictable weather. Please buy and place the order now for one tent with price under $250, sleeping capacity at least 3, packed weight at most 3kg, warranty at least 2 years, a customer rating of at least 4 stars, waterproof rating at least 1200mm, and must have full-coverage rainfly.
